extracted.intended_audience: writers (poets, fiction and creative nonfiction) interested in applying to attend the Bread Loaf Writers’ Conference
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for applying to and attending the Bread Loaf Writers’ Conference (Ripton, VT), including submission limits, fees, tuition, dates, program offerings, faculty, accessibility, and contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript submission limits
rubrics_metrics.description: To apply, writers submitted up to 10 pages of poetry or no more than 6,000 words of prose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the stated maximum for application materials; applicants should prepare work that fits within these length limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meet the stated calendar deadline to have your submission considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the fee with your submission as specified; check the conference website for payment methods or fee-waiver information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition and inclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition, which includes lodging and meals, is $4,440.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tuition covers room and board during the conference; budget for tuition in addition to application fee and travel. Visit the conference website for payment/registration details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial aid availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants who need assistance should consult the conference website or contact organizers for details and application procedures for financial aid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program offerings / participant activities
rubrics_metrics.description: The conference features workshops in poetry, fiction, and creative nonfiction, as well as lectures; craft classes; meetings with editors, agents, and publishers; and readings by faculty and guests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be prepared to participate in workshops, craft classes, and meetings with industry professionals; the program components indicate the kinds of activities and professional development available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty includes listed poets, fiction writers, and creative nonfiction writers (e.g., Catherine Barnett, Jericho Brown, Alexander Chee, Elizabeth McCracken, Toni Jensen, Paul Lisicky, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The named faculty indicate the conference's artistic focus and mentorship opportunities; applicants may consider faculty expertise when deciding to apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event dates and location
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2026 Bread Loaf Writers’ Conference will be held from August 12 to August 22 amid the Green Mountains of Ripton, Vermont.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should confirm availability for the full conference dates and plan travel to Ripton, VT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility accommodations
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessibility accommodations include accessible sidewalks, pathways, and doorways; elevators to dorm spaces; accessible bathrooms and dorm rooms; accessible event spaces; accessible parking; and assistive listening devices for lectures and readings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact Middlebury College ADA coordinator Jodi Litchfield at (802) 443-5936 or ada@middlebury.edu for additional accessibility details and to arrange accommodations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and additional information
rubrics_metrics.description: Website: https://www.middlebury.edu/writers-conferences/writers-conference; Contact: Bread Loaf Conferences, Middlebury College, 204 College Street, Middlebury, VT 05753. (802) 443-5286. Jason Lamb, Coordinator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visit the official website or contact the conference office/coordinator for full application instructions, updated deadlines, payment/registration procedures, and any changes to program details.
